name: Somberek (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, red and white in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Somberek (a shield of green and white with a plant, a lion and ploughshares) below the name SOMBEREK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
